_about: v83: AI credits. Every LLM call is written to the usage ledger (ai_call_log) whatever 'mode' is. mode: off = ledger only | shadow = ledger + the credits each call WOULD cost (nothing is deducted or blocked; use it to calibrate grants from real usage) | enforce = credits are deducted and AI features are blocked at zero. Charge for a call = real provider cost (USD) x markup / credit_value_usd, in credits (stored as millicredits). markup must be >= min_markup (5). Monthly plan grants expire at the end of the business's calendar month and are spent first; top-up credits never expire (expiry_days null) and are spent after. A failed call, a call answered from the cache, an answer that failed our own checks and the first attempt of a retry are NOT charged (the accepted answer is). Admin / demo / test accounts are logged but never charged: a platform admin acting in a business, or a business with "ai_credit_exempt": true in tenants.json. NUMBERS MARKED placeholder ARE NOT CALIBRATED - read real cost per feature from the ledger (shadow mode) before enforcing. Validate with: python tools/check_ai_credits.py TOP-UP (v87): the owner picks the number of credits (top_up.min_credits .. max_credits in steps of step_credits); price = credits / 1000 x top_up.price_per_1000[currency], rounded to the currency's decimals. Prices are placeholders (placeholder_prices).
